rows.name: enemy sprite layout rows
rows.notes:
Super Mario Bros. (World) enemy sprite layout table, read with read_memory prgRom + view_tiles. The table is a flat array of 2-tile pairs consumed as 6-byte (3-pair) sprite forms by the routine at CPU $EBAA (LDA $E73E,X / LDA $E73F,X / JMP $F282, which draws one 2x2 block per call, X advancing by 2). Corrected bounds: the table runs prgRom 0x673E..0x683F = CPU $E73E..$E83F, 258 bytes = 43 rows of 6 bytes (the earlier note's 0x6744 start was 1 row late; 0x673E is a real row; and 0x6840 begins a SEPARATE 27-byte offset table indexed by the sprite graphics type $EF: LDA $E840,Y at CPU $E92A, whose entries are row offsets/6: type 0,1,3,4->0x0C row3, type 2->0x00 row1, type 5->0xA8 row29, type 6->0x54 row15 (Goomba), type 7->0x3C row11, type 8->0xEA row40, type 9,14,15,16->0x18 row5, type 10,11,20->0x48 row13, type 12->0xCC row35, type 13->0xC0 row33, type 17->0x90 row25, type 18->0x24 row7, type 19->0xFF (none), type 21->0x9C row27, type 22->0xD2 row36, type 23->0xD8 row37, type 24->0xF0 row41, type 25->0xF6 row42, type 26->0xFC row43).

Each row = six CHR tile ids in draw order (top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), $FC = blank. Tiles are sprite pattern table $0000.

FIRST row = 0x673E; LAST row = 0x683A. The rows at the extremes are the ones that stop making sense as full enemy frames: 0x673E (Buzzy/shell, the first) is a valid 16x16 form, and 0x683A (F0 F0 + four blanks) is an 8x16 fragment rather than a full 2x3 enemy frame. Rows 0x6828-0x683A (E7-EE, F0-F3) are small effect/object forms and the least certain identifications; the Goomba (0x6792), Koopa (0x674A) and shell/stomp (0x67C8) rows are confirmed.

PROOF that a row selects the drawn enemy (hack eval-sheet2-rows-b, ledger seq 1): write_memory prgRom 0x6792 = FC A5 A6 A7 A8 A9 (the Koopa Troopa row) with a reason; reset_emulator; then played title Start, Start and held Right to the first World 1-1 Goomba. list_sprites then decoded that enemy's OAM as tiles $A5,$FC,$A7,$A6,$A9,$A8 (was $FC,$FC,$70,$71,$72,$73) - i.e. the Goomba was drawn using the Koopa Troopa's tiles - and the screenshot showed the enemy on the hill drawn with the Koopa form (sprite palette 7 still applied, since the palette comes from the enemy type, not the row). undo_edit seq 1 restored prgRom 0x6792 = FC FC 70 71 72 73, and use_hack default switched the ledger back. So the 6-byte row at prgRom 0x6792 is read by the game and selects which sprite is drawn.
